name: proptechusa-ufc-intelligence-api
description: PropTechUSA UFC Intelligence API — commercial gateway, developer portal and distribution layer over the canonical PropBetEdge UFC API (LHBUSA/UFC).

scripts.generate: npm run openapi:build && npm run entitlements:doc
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run dev --workspace=gateway
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace=gateway
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run deploy:production --workspace=gateway
